name: @qf-jarvis/groq-staging-smoke
description: QF Jarvis Groq STAGING smoke harness (QFJ-S1A, ADR-0061). A one-shot, staging-only, synthetic-only executable that clears the four S1 activation blockers: a concrete masked-TTY credential resolver outside the model gateway, a single-run harness over the existing bindGroqStagingProvider, harness-owned AbortController/timeout, and an exact prompt identity. It accepts only a non-secret config path, owns one fixed synthetic prompt literal, binds once, invokes once, prints only sanitized codes and reference ids, and exits. No key in argv/config/env/disk/log/event/report/Git; no retry; one HTTP request maximum. No QuickFurno Core, Jarvis runtime, n8n, WhatsApp, send, delivery, persistence, database, rollout, or activation. Model output is a discarded staging draft; QuickFurno Core remains the final business authority.
